_comment: H2 profile -> serving-params map. PROJECTED defaults encoding the 12-config hardware matrix (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-11-agent-capabilities-and-hardware-matrix.md). install.ps1 Step 6 reads the profile id + ram_tier emitted by detect.ps1 and renders the backend llama-swap template with these values. H3 (selftest.ps1) MEASURES on each real box and refines these numbers; nothing here is measured yet.

_fields.cache_ram_mib_by_ram_tier: TOP-LEVEL (not per tier): llama-server host-RAM prompt cache (--cache-ram, MiB) rendered into every llama.cpp seat by RAM tier. The server parks evicted slots' KV in RAM and restores them on a prefix match (agent-loop steps, re-delegated docs). llama-server default is 8192 on every build; these values replace it per box. The FLOOR RULE (2026-09-21): llama-server's own default is 8192 MiB on every build, so this map may only hand a box LESS than that where its RAM genuinely cannot carry it (min = a 4 GB Vivobook), and otherwise hands the bigger boxes what they actually have. The first cut broke that rule in the losing direction — 2048 on the 32 GB nodes and 6144 on the 64 GB one, i.e. a silent cut below the default they had been running on. Values are still unmeasured against a contract stream; Task 3a of plans/2026-09-20-llamacpp-prompt-cache-tiers.md sets them from measurement. A full 32k slot costs ~1.1 GB, so these hold roughly 1 / 7 / 15 / 22 of them. vLLM seats keep LMCache and never get this flag.
_fields.alt_backends: optional: extra serving backends this tier renders BESIDE its primary one on the same box (today only ["cpu"]: the CPU seat family — the tier's chat weights as <id>-cpu entries run by a CPU llama-server build, joined to the interactive set; rendered only when `install render --llama-bin-cpu <dir>` is given). Declared per tier and MEASURED before it ships: binxarn amd-gcn 2026-09-20.
_fields.long_ctx_size: optional: the LONG window a tier serves on a dedicated opt-in twin seat (the `-262k` entry the template renders with a literal --ctx-size), for tiers whose extra cards buy context. 0/absent = no long twin. The composite tier routes window overflow to it.
_fields.kv_type: q8_0|f16 -> --cache-type-k/--cache-type-v (kept symmetric; q8_0 V requires flash-attn on).
_fields.agent_ctx_tokens: value for the agent's -ctx-tokens (compaction budget); matches ctx_size.
_fields.resident_tier: the workhorse seat (gemma4-26b-a4b|offload-e4b|gemma4-e2b) — ttl 300 like every entry; resident is a ROLE in the matrix set, never permanence. SEEDS the agent planner seat: install seed derives config agent_model from it when it differs from the workhorse (internal/tierseed); override or blank via config_seed.agent_model.
_fields.include_26b: whether the 26B-A4B model appears in the rendered yaml + swap group at all.
_fields.include_qwen38: whether the Qwen3.8-27B coder/agent model renders into the serving yaml (entry + resident-set membership where the template is all-resident) and its GGUF+mmproj join the install download set. Mirrors the include_26b mechanism.
_fields.include_qwen35_4b: whether the Qwen3.5-4B AGENT seat renders into the serving yaml (entry + swappable-set membership) and its GGUF joins the install download set. Mirrors the include_qwen38 mechanism. This is the small-tier counterpart: a 3.5GB agent seat for tiers whose workhorse is too weak to plan well but which cannot afford a 27B.
_fields.include_qwen35_9b: whether the Qwen3.5-9B AGENT seat renders into the serving yaml (entry + swappable-set membership) and its GGUF joins the install download set. Mirrors the include_qwen35_4b mechanism, one weight class up: a 5.6GB agent seat for the 8GB tiers (6344 MiB at 16K / 6696 MiB at 32K, measured on the blackwell-8 reference box 2026-08-22). MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with include_qwen35_4b - both entries claim the agent-seat alias, and the renderer refuses a tier that sets both.
_fields.include_mimo_9b: whether the mimo-9b-agent seat (XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B, bartowski GGUF Q4_K_M) renders into the serving yaml (entry + swappable-set membership) and its GGUF joins the install download set. A SECOND 8GB-class agent seat measured 2026-09-24 a coin-flip quality tie against include_qwen35_9b (18/18 shape B x6 both 8GB reference boxes; shape C 5/5 vs 4/5, splitting by box) with a smaller VRAM footprint at the same 65536 window. It claims the SAME agent-seat alias as include_qwen35_4b and include_qwen35_9b, but pairing it with EITHER is no longer a render refusal (2026-09-24, the amd-gcn onboarding, superseding the 4B refusal shipped with this seat's own introduction): the smaller entry stays rendered as the tier's un-aliased ROLLBACK seat (the renderer moves the shared agent-seat alias to mimo-9b-agent via that entry's own __Q354B_AGENT_ALIAS__/__Q359B_AGENT_ALIAS__ token). REQUIRES llama.cpp >= b11102 (upstream llama.cpp #29319 - an older build misroutes MiMo's compact tool-call XML to the Qwen3-Coder parser and every tool call runs to the token cap). On a Vulkan UMA tier (amd-gcn) the rendered entry serves the TIER's own window/KV/flash-attn (__CTX__/__KV_K__/__KV_V__/__FLASH_ATTN__), not the literal 65536/q8_0 pin the CUDA 8GB tiers measured on their fixed-VRAM cards — see llama-swap.linux-vulkan.yaml.
_fields.moe_26b: gpu (-ngl 99, experts on GPU) | cpu_moe (--cpu-moe, experts in RAM) | drop (omit 26B). When cpu_moe, install.ps1 drops the 26B if ram_tier is low/min (no RAM path).
_fields.backend: the llama-swap.win-<backend> template this profile renders from (cuda|vulkan|cpu|dual-cuda).
_fields.dual_resident: dual-gpu only: render two models resident (no shared exclusive swap group).
_fields.gpu_env: env vars added to EVERY model in the rendered serving config, appended after whatever the template already declares. Was an `if ($profileId -match '^blackwell-')` branch inside install.ps1, so a Linux install of the same tier silently did not get it. CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES pins the device (hybrid-graphics can resolve the default to -1); CUDA_MODULE_LOADING=LAZY is llama.cpp #22696.
_fields.media_seats: ALIAS-backed media capabilities this tier serves, rendered into BOTH the llama-swap models map and the harness config binding that routes to them (internal/mediaseat). Each seat: kind (vision|stt), name (the llama-swap model id AND the binding value), aliases, model/mmproj/vad_model (relative to the models dir), bin + lib_dir for a seat that is not llama-server (may carry __OFFLOAD_HOME__/__EXE__), ctx_size (vision runs its own smaller window), residency (swappable|resident - a ROLE, since group names are per-template), ttl. A tier declaring NO seat leaves vision_model/stt_model empty and the route honestly defers. FILE-backed media (image/video/music) is NOT here - those are spawn-per-job subprocesses under the GPU lease, seeded via config_seed and derived by internal/mediacap.
_fields.composes: COMPOSITE TIERS (ADR 0039, 0.116.0): the tier ids this tier is a COMPLETE instance of at the same time (blackwell-3x16 composes blackwell-16 and blackwell-2x16). Every id must be a tier in this table, none may be composite itself, and a tier never composes itself. Seeded into config as tiers = composes + this id and tier_profile = this id (internal/tierseed.Resolve); health and offload_status advertise them. Requires layers - composes without layers seeds nothing and is refused at parse.
_fields.layers: COMPOSITE TIERS: the device layers this box places work onto, seeded VERBATIM into config.layers and validated at parse (Doc.Validate) and at resolve (config.ValidateLayers). KEYS ARE STRICT: every layers[] / layers[].seats[] key must be one documented below, spelled exactly - a key the decoder cannot match is refused by tier and JSON path at parse (tierseed.ParseDoc, so the installer's embedded copy too) and at config load (config.ValidateLayerKeys), never dropped to a 0 that turns a fail-closed guard fail-open. A box whose config carries no layers has one implicit layer and is byte-identical on every result, health, status and ledger surface. ONE placement rule (internal/placement.Decide) reads these at runtime on the box, on the delegator for a remote node's advertised layers, and again at admission on the node.
_fields.layers[].name: the layer id placement records and a contract may request (`layer` on the wire): single | pair | triple | display. Unique per box, ^[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}$.
_fields.layers[].tier: the composed tier this layer stands for (blackwell-16 for single, blackwell-2x16 for pair). Must be in composes or be this tier.
_fields.layers[].devices: the device SETS this layer may occupy, documentary ("0", "2" | "0,2" | "0,1,2" | "1"). Seats carry the actual pin; placed.devices on a result is the SEAT's pin, never this list.
_fields.layers[].seats: the roles served on this layer, at most one per role. The pair layer's agent seat may be left BARE ({"role": "agent"}): Resolve fills model/device/ctx_tokens/max_inflight from vllm_seat (first alias, device, max_model_len, max_num_seqs) when the box runs the vLLM seat, else from fallback_agent_model/fallback_agent_ctx_tokens on the seat's device, so one number lives in one place.
_fields.layers[].opt_in: a layer that is never the default for any task class: the triple layer is entered on an explicit context_class long only, never on load.
_fields.layers[].dormant: declared but never placed until the operator flips it to false after reading the measurement (the display layer, council R7). One config edit, operator-only.
_fields.layers[].display_device: the device the display guards read live: a CUDA index in this table; the live box pins it by GPU-UUID because the board reorders indices on power loss.
_fields.layers[].display_floor_gib: the VRAM the desktop keeps on display_device. The display_floor guard admits a seat only while free(display_device) - seat.display_footprint_gib >= this (a free-VRAM-only check admitted a 10.5 GB load onto a card with 9 GB free; council R6). >= 4 GiB on the 3-card box: the 2026-09-04 starvation dropped the desktop to 720p and forced a reboot.
_fields.layers[].guards: the live checks an admission on this layer must pass, from display_floor | presence | host_ram. Every guard fails CLOSED: a probe that cannot read refuses, and operator_presence defaults to present.
_fields.layers[].seats[].role: router | agent | long | ocr | vision | stt - the closed vocabulary the placement table keys on. router carries no model (its rungs come from model_map / the cascade); every other role needs one.
_fields.layers[].seats[].model: the llama-swap id or alias served for this role on this layer. It must be a seat the composite serving template renders (D5 checked union).
_fields.layers[].seats[].device: this seat's CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES pin under CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID: "0" | "2" | "0,2" | "0,1,2" | "1". Required on every seat. Device 1 is the display card on the 3-card box: only the triple and display layers may name it.
_fields.layers[].seats[].ctx_tokens: the seat's SERVED window, read from config and never probed before admission. Sizes the contract context cap (min(2 MiB, largest window x 3)) and the window-overflow decision.
_fields.layers[].seats[].max_inflight: vLLM max_num_seqs for the seat; 0 = never saturated by count (llama.cpp seats). A saturated pair is RECORDED in placed.reason, never acted on (council R2).
_fields.layers[].seats[].footprint_gib: VRAM this seat puts on EACH device of its pin, measured alone (26B 13,301 MiB; vl-8b 11,751; whisper ~2,182; 27b-262k 14.3+15.5 GB; flash-next-262k 13.0/10.5/12.5 GB; the vLLM pair seat ~15 GiB per card at util 0.90). Used to name the eviction a placement would cause on a shared device set.
_fields.layers[].seats[].display_footprint_gib: VRAM this seat puts on the layer's display_device. REQUIRED (> 0) on a display_floor-guarded layer for every seat whose pin includes the display device - a 0 degrades the guard to the rejected free-VRAM check, and config refuses it at load.
_fields.layers[].seats[].host_ram_gib: host RAM the seat holds while loaded (experts on CPU: flash-next-262k ~70 GB). The host_ram guard refuses when free host RAM is below it. REQUIRED (> 0) on every seat of a host_ram-guarded layer - the guard is free >= this, and a 0 admits the load on every box; config refuses the omission at load and the table at parse.
_fields.layers[].seats[].prefill_tps: measured prompt-processing rate. The long seats are entered only when tokens / this <= the contract's budget: flash-next-262k prefills at 69 t/s, so a 200k prompt is ~48 min against a 900 s cap; the pair's 27b-262k at 1,197 t/s takes window overflow instead. REQUIRED (> 0) on every long seat - a 0 rate is a division by zero on the first long placement; config refuses the omission at load and the table at parse.
_fields.layers[].seats[].model_map: router role only: route key (workhorse | triage) -> the twin model served on THIS layer, so the dormant display layer can substitute its device-1 twins for the cascade's rungs.

_accelerator_fields.kind: npu | tpu — the device class (hailo-8l is an npu, coral-edgetpu a tpu). An accelerator is ADDITIVE to a box's GPU tier (ADR 0024): `profile` stays one string and `accelerators` lists what rides beside it.
_accelerator_fields.owns: the offload_* capabilities this accelerator serves EXCLUSIVELY when present; the GPU tier keeps everything else (VQA/description stay on the VLM; OCR stays GPU-primary with engine:npu as the caller's explicit fast path).
_accelerator_fields.config_seed: config.json keys merged AFTER the GPU tier's seed (internal/tierseed.ResolveAccelerators). __HAILO_HOME__ expands to the Hailo repo checkout (installer env HAILO_HOME, default <OFFLOAD_HOME>/hailo).
_accelerator_fields.detect: how detect.ps1 / hwdetect recognise the device — documentation of the rule implemented in code.

coral-edgetpu.detect: /sys/class/apex/apex_0/status reads ALIVE (gasket/apex driver bound; Linux only — Windows has no apex driver and never matches)
coral-edgetpu.notes: Coral Edge TPU (M.2 A+E on the Lenovo M720q, PCI 03:00.0; one id for the whole family — USB/M.2/Dual all run the same _edgetpu.tflite artifacts). Runtime as measured 2026-09-04 (Ecosystem/Lenovo M720q/2026-09-04_coral-tpu/SETUP.md): feranick gasket-dkms 1.0-18.4 + libedgetpu1-std 16.0TF2.19.1 + ai-edge-litert 2.2.0 (cp314); MobileNet v2 iNat p50 3.16 ms / ~300 inf/s, 70-71 C sustained, no throttle; -max measured indistinguishable (the ~3 ms floor is the Gen2 x1 transfer, not compute) and purged. The tier READS that configuration and never rewrites it: the sidecar (accelerators/coral/server.py, harness-spawned on demand over loopback, self-exits idle) reads sysfs temp/status only. Four capabilities in v1, every model from google-coral/test_data (Apache-2.0) and verified by sha256 in accelerators/coral/models.json: classify_image (EfficientNet-EdgeTPU-S ImageNet; MobileNet v2 iNat birds/insects/plants), object_detect (EfficientDet-Lite0/1/2 COCO), semantic_segment (DeepLabV3 MNv2 Pascal, 21 classes — semantic, NOT the Hailo's instance `segment`), image_embed (EfficientNet-EdgeTPU-S extractor, 1280-d, space efficientnet-edgetpu-s — not CLIP, so no text tower and no zero_shot). Shared-name rule (D5): object_detect and image_embed are capability names one owner per box — the FIRST listed accelerator that owns a name registers it. Deploy on the Lenovo (D8): CORAL_HOME=<OFFLOAD_HOME>/coral with its own venv from the staged cp314 wheels; the fleet unit's ProtectHome=yes hides ~/coral-venv, which stays the operator's bench.

blackwell-16.notes: Config #1 (5060 Ti 16GB, Blackwell sm_120). 26B resident full-GPU (-ngl 99). REQUIRES the Blackwell CUDA-12.8 sm_120 build (Task H4) - the pinned 12.4 asset lacks sm_120 and the 13.x asset segfaults the MMQ kernel into a ~5.6x-slower cuBLAS fallback. H3 may push ctx to 64K with q8. config_seed: quality-first media bindings attributed to this exact tier [see the MEASURED-STATUS CLARIFICATION at the end of this note — this string simultaneously claimed PROVEN, PROJECTED, and 'informed by a LIVE REFERENCE, not a runtime measurement' about the same seat] (bf16 O1 = 3.9min/2048 render via RAM offload; needs the model downloads + >=~48GB system RAM — see SETUP-AGENT). TIER DURABILITY (2026-08-14, operator rule): the pooled 2x16 tier moved its image seat to Krea 2 Turbo (24.5GB — physically does not fit one 16GB card); HiDream-O1 bf16 via RAM offload REMAINS this tier's measured, quality-first binding. A 32GB-tier seat change is never an argument to change a 16GB-tier seed; this tier evolves only on measurements taken at 16GB. PROJECTED. J-media 2026-07-28: media_seats are informed by a LIVE REFERENCE, not a runtime measurement. This tier IS the workstation, and its hand-built llama-swap serves the same qwen3-vl-8b (Q8_0 weights + FULL-PRECISION F16 mmproj, ctx 16384) plus whisper large-v3-turbo. The Q8 + F16-tower pairing is the 8->16GB unlock: Q4 is where small-screenshot-text fidelity died, and this one seat owns screenshots/GUI/document OCR, which is why no separate OCR model exists (hence the 'ocr' alias here and on the other tiers that inherit this seat). DELTAS FROM LIVE, deliberate and NOT measured: the seat inherits this tier's q8_0 KV while the live entry sets no cache-type at all and therefore runs F16; and it adds --image-max-tokens 2048 + --no-context-shift, neither of which live carries. Same weights and window, tighter KV, an explicit image bound. Swappable, so the ~10GB seat is the only heavy seat loaded. (The former qwen3-asr HQ STT tier was RETIRED 2026-08-14 — Seat Frontier Leg 2 consolidated STT to the whisper seat after a paired house A/B tied on quality; stt_model_hq stays empty, hq falls back to stt_model by design.) TIER-DOCTRINE PASS 2026-08-16: agent seat pointed at the VALIDATED thinking-on 26B agent entry (0/15->12/15 at D1 with reasoning on, 2026-08-10) instead of the derived reasoning-off cascade seat (measured 0% as agent). Same weights as the 26B — no new download. Capability parity with the twin-arch sibling(s) is field-identical by design; the arch split (sm86/sm120/sm70) is a BUILD concern only. MEASURED-STATUS CLARIFICATION 2026-09-07: this note previously asserted PROVEN, PROJECTED and 'informed by a LIVE REFERENCE, not a runtime measurement' about the same seat — three incompatible claims in one string, which is exactly why a notes field must never be read as a measurement status. WHAT IS TRUE: this tier HAD a real reference box. The Qube ran as blackwell-16 on a SINGLE RTX 5060 Ti 16GB (sm_120, 16310 MiB, PCIe Gen3 x8 electrical) + i9-10980XE + 128GB DDR4-3400 from 2026-07-12 to 2026-08-02; the classifier self-identified blackwell-16 on it 2026-07-27; and a capability report from that box is committed at docs/tiers/reports/blackwell-16-node-b.md (banner: HISTORICAL). Primary artifacts: six llama-bench JSON receipts dated 2026-07-13 (gpt-oss-20b pp512 5184.92 / tg128 122.14; E4B 4515.53 / 93.94; 12b 2204.90 / 47.37; 26B-A4B -ot exps=CPU 231.60 / 27.84; Qwen3.6-27B at -ngl 99 82.55 / 1.162 = the 16GB spill ceiling), a 4-rung roster validation through the live llama-swap (e2b 154.5 -> e4b 95.7 -> 12b+MTP 82.1 -> 26b 32.5 tok/s), and the Phase-D KV/TTFT and compaction-flip runs, both scoped in their own text to 'single box (Qube 5060 Ti)'. WHAT IS NOT TRUE: the box never ran install.ps1, so this tier's INSTALLER-RENDERED serving params were never selftested there (the committed report reads 'hardware tier: UNKNOWN'), and the '3.9 min / 2048' HiDream-O1 bf16 figure is a prose sentence in the 2026-07-16 quality-first spec with no timing artifact anywhere. The box gained a second card on 2026-08-02 and a third on 2026-08-31, so this tier has NO CURRENT reference box. AGENT LANE THINKING POLICY MEASURED 2026-09-17 (register D-119 follow-up; the H-04 blind instrument on one RTX 5060 Ti, 3 lenses x 8 packets, pack --axis thinking): gemma-4-26b-agent with agent_thinking off at 4,096 = 7.31 vs the shipped auto = 6.73 (gap 0.58, head-to-head 19/24, every lens agrees -> SEPARATED); the think block costs specificity and coverage and buys padding (8 degenerate flags vs 2) while accuracy is level (8.94 vs 9.02); no-think finals are 107-135 tokens in 7-9 s per contract. config_seed.agent_thinking is therefore 'off' for this lane -- the seat entry keeps --reasoning on and the harness renders the no-think turn per request (chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking:false). The completion budget was measured the same day: 1,024 vs 4,096 at thinking auto = TIE (6.76 vs 6.30, gap 0.46), so the budget seed is unchanged. Record 'Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-09-17-d119-26b-budget-bake/' (out-thinking/).

vllm_seat.measured: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB (Blackwell sm_120; the Qube's headless card, PCI index 2, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES pinned to it), vLLM 0.29.0 + flashinfer 0.6.18 + the checkpoint's embedding patch, V1 model runner (WSL2), storeless, 2026-09-16/17. Qwen3.8-27B 3-bit GSQ, the same checkpoint ampere-16 seats (ADR 0049), measured on THIS silicon rather than copied -- and the copy would have been wrong: the A2's launch line (kv_cache_dtype fp8_e5m2) produces NaN tokens on this card under vLLM 0.29 (raw completions `<tool_call>!!!!...` at 8,580 prompt tokens, a hallucinated prompt at 290; every digest-8 contract deferred unparsed_tool_call in two runs). Isolated one variable per arm: transformers version, the flashinfer sampler flag and prefix caching all irrelevant; TRITON_ATTN refuses the model; bf16 KV (auto -> FLASH_ATTN) coherent; fp8 (e4m3fn) on the same FLASHINFER backend coherent. So kv_cache_dtype is fp8 here and never fp8_e5m2. OPERATING POINT: max_model_len 49,152 at util 0.92 -- model 10.4 GiB, KV 2.84 GiB = 76,314 tokens (1.55x), 14,024 of 16,311 MiB (65,536 @ 0.92 also fits: 80,554 tokens, 1.23x). Single-stream 27.75 tok/s, TTFT p50 0.43 s, 4-stream aggregate 64.39 tok/s (16.1/req, 0 failed); digest-8 at the bound lane (thinking off / 4,096 / 900 s / vendor sampling) 8/8, 0 deferred, 364 s for all eight. Blind quality (Opus judge, 8 packets x 3 lenses, positions balanced): 8.53 overall (accuracy 9.30, specificity 8.80, coverage 8.29; 2 possible / 3 minor fabrication flags, the same count as the llama.cpp arm) -- level with the same checkpoint on the A2 (8.46) and below the llama.cpp IQ3_S+MTP arm (9.30, SEPARATED, 23/24). agent_seat_tok_s 27.75 seeds the D-03 auto wall. Cache server: none -- measured storeless; LMCache 0.5.4's MP connector rejects vLLM 0.29's kv_layout (D-117). On a WSL2 box with vLLM >= 0.29 the launcher pins the V1 runner (seat_fg.sh, version-gated: 0.28's V2 runner runs on WSL2; VLLM_WSL2_ENABLE_PIN_MEMORY=1 lets 0.29's V2 runner start and it then dies in kernel warm-up with CUDA error: invalid device ordinal). config_seed.agent_max_tokens 4,096 is the llama.cpp fallback lane's budget, MEASURED 2026-09-17 (masterplan D-119): gemma-4-26b-agent at this tier's own line (-ngl 99, 32,768, q8_0 KV, reasoning on) on one 5060 Ti fits at 14,540 of 16,311 MiB, loads in 16 s and decodes at 100 tok/s; blind Opus (H-04, 3 lenses x 8 packets, pack --axis max_tokens) 1,024 vs 4,096 = TIE (6.76 vs 6.30, gap 0.46 under the 0.5 bar, head-to-head 18/24, both arms 8/8) -- the seed stays at 4,096, where every contract completes uncut; at 1,024 every final is cut by the think block and re-issued no-think at 4,096. Record 'Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-09-17-d119-26b-budget-bake/'. The tier's llama.cpp agent lane (gemma-4-26b-agent) stays the fallback. Record: 'Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-09-16-16gb-tier-pass/' (blackwell-16/, raw-toolcall-test/, judge-27b-49k-bw/, live-cutover/README.md).

blackwell-32.notes: Config #13 (RTX 5090 32GB / RTX PRO 4500 32GB, Blackwell sm_120). ALL-RESIDENT: the whole roster (~21GB weights) stays hot with no swap group; 64K ctx q8_0 KV inside 32GB. config_seed applies only to a FRESH ~/.local-offload/config.json (install Step 8). Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-16-blackwell-profile-tiers-design.md. PROJECTED - H3 measures the real ceiling. J-media 2026-07-28: seats are RESIDENT here (win-cuda-resident places only that role - nothing on this tier swaps), so VRAM is ADDITIVE with the roster. Arithmetic, stated so it can be checked: the ~21GB roster figure is THIS TIER'S OWN pre-existing note, not a new measurement; E4B+mmproj at ctx 4096 (~4.5GB) plus whisper (~1.6GB) is about +6GB, which spends roughly HALF of the ~11GB the original 32GB design left implicit for 64K q8_0 KV, leaving ~5GB for four co-resident models. The 8B (~10GB) does not fit at all, which is why 48/72 get it and this tier does not. Because nothing swaps on this template, an operator who finds KV tight must DROP a seat rather than expect the solver to recover. Also note this backend has no Linux template (cuda-resident is Windows-only). PROJECTED - verify the budget on real silicon before relying on it. TIER-DOCTRINE PASS 2026-08-16 (PROJECTED): vision seat was e4b-vision — WORSE than the 16GB tiers' 8B seat, pure drift — now qwen3-vl-8b. krea2 + ltx25(1280x704) seeded. agent_model stays derived (26b-a4b): the 27B cannot join the all-resident set beside the 26B in 32GB; the thinking-agent upgrade for this tier is an open bake-off item.

vllm_seat.measured: The SAME seat blackwell-3x16 seeds, on the same silicon: the RTX 5060 Ti pair. On the 3-card reference box the pair is devices 0,2 (PCI order, the 5070 Ti display card sits at 1); on a 2-card box it is 0,1. Qwen3.8-27B-INT4 has 64 layers, 4 KV heads (so TP3 is impossible: pipeline), full attention every 4th layer, and an UNTIED bf16 lm_head (248,320 x 5,120 = 2.37 GiB) — the last stage carries it and the first carries the embedding (2.37) plus the vision tower (0.86). Order 2,1,0 puts the 5070 Ti in the MIDDLE, where it holds neither; order 0,1,2 failed LMCache register_kv_caches on the card-2 last rank twice. 28 layers per rank is the ceiling for a 262,144 window at 3.75 GiB of KV per card (pool 269,676; 29 layers caps it at 235,200). Card 0's compute = 23 layers + lm_head (~3 layer-equivalents) = 26 < card 2's 28. The 5070 Ti keeps 18-22% free with a 2.6-3.3 GB desktop and ~13% with a 4.1 GB one: the seat's own share is ~10 GB, most of it fixed per-process cost (vLLM + NCCL + the LMCache server's context), not layers. Needle 23.7k: cold 16.6 s, warm 0.48 s. L1 staging 16 GB is required, not a default (raised from 8 on 2026-09-22): this hybrid model stores ~205 MB per 1568-token chunk, a 2 GB L1 failed its stores, and 8 GB at the 0.80 watermark left too little free to stage an L2 hit back (short by 10 blocks). L2 SERVES: the evict phase got 0 external hits until the per-rank layout overlay patch (each pipeline rank's KV layout bound to its own pages); with it the cache-server store serves L2 hits back to the pipeline seat. One caveat stays open: the FIRST request after an MP server start gets 0 L2 hits (and recomputes) until register-time binding lands. chat_template qwen3-fold-system.jinja (shipped under setup/templates/vllm-seat/chat-templates/) folds 2+ leading system messages into one, which the upstream template rejects with a 400; a single-system prompt renders byte-identically. enable_prompt_tokens_details reports cached_tokens per request. ampere-16.notes: BINDING HELD 2026-09-16 (same day, after the live check): the 27B entry RENDERS and its weights download, but config_seed.agent_model stays on the 4B because the winner cannot finish a DEFAULT remote contract. Measured live on the deployed seat: contracts/digest-8.json through the fleet node returned 2/8 and then 0/8, every failure 'wall timeout after 300s'. Root cause, traced in code: the delegator stamps timeout_sec = core.AgentTimeoutSecDefault (300) onto every subtask in internal/delegate/intake.go before dispatch, the node's decoder leaves it (internal/core/agentwire.go DecodeAgentContractWithCap), and Config.AgentTimeoutSec is read ONLY on local-run paths (cmd/local-agent/main.go, internal/mcpserver agentTimeout) - so NO node-side setting extends a dispatched contract's wall, and a 6.3 tok/s seat cannot fit one. Setting agent_thinking off (the policy it was measured under) did not help: 0/8. The 4B seat re-verified 8/8 at walls 36-132 s on the same set. So the QUALITY verdict stands unchanged (24/24 blind) and the seat is available by name for callers that pass timeout_sec up to the 900 s cap; it becomes the default binding when the wall is derived from the seat's measured rate (register D-03) rather than from a constant. AGENT SEAT RE-AUDITED 2026-09-16 (ADR 0047, register A-07; record 'Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-09-16-a07-ampere16-seat-reaudit'): the seat is qwen38-27b-agent = Qwen3.8-27B UD-IQ3_S with the MTP head embedded in the same GGUF (--spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 3), llama.cpp b10991, LITERAL --ctx-size 49152, q8_0 KV, --reasoning off. Measured on the reference A2 at its accepted 40 W / 1200 MHz profile, cooled to <=64 C before every arm, all arms at a matched budget (thinking off, step 4096, wall 900 s, one contract per delegate call): 14,410 MiB of a 15,356 MiB card INCLUDING the ~456 MiB memory-stack embedder already resident, 8/8 contracts with zero deferrals at walls 111-806 s, drafter acceptance 0.592 on free text, prompt 76.5 tok/s, decode 6.3 tok/s. Blind (24 Opus judgements, 3 lenses, Latin-balanced) it beats the previous seat qwen3.5-4b-vllm 24/24, gemma-4-12B+MTP 24/24 and gpt-oss-20b+EAGLE-3 24/24; overall 9.32 vs the 4B's 5.39, which took zero firsts and fourteen lasts of 24. The prior 'measured tie' of 2026-09-14 is WITHDRAWN: it was taken on a card that ran stock and thermally throttled 09-10..09-15 (A-103), at the node's 1,024-token step budget, with the 12B capped at a 32k window. The vllm_seat declaration is REMOVED from this tier (it existed to render the 4B as the agent seat); the llama.cpp qwen3.5-4b-agent entry stays rendered as the fallback and the live Lenovo unit is untouched. KNOWN COSTS: the seat pads (102 degenerate findings flagged vs the runner-up's 1 - ask contracts for a bounded list) and it is slow (6.3 tok/s, so agent_timeout_sec is seeded 900; at a default 300 s contract FitFinalBudget floors the final answer at 1,024 tokens). OPEN per INV-6: IQ3_S vs IQ3_XXS is a TIE on the instrument (gap 0.40 < 0.50) - IQ3_S ships on faithfulness 9.40 vs 8.64, 18 firsts to 6, two genuine inventions found in IQ3_XXS by the mechanical screen and none in IQ3_S, and IQ3_XXS's only rationale (a larger window) measured void (81,920 aborts at load; it held 57,344). Ampere >=12GB band (3090-class defensive). 26B resident full-GPU. config_seed: quality-first media bindings (bf16 needs no fp8 hardware; verified on the 16GB Blackwell tier — needs the model downloads + >=~48GB system RAM). The 'ocr' alias rides on this shared VLM (one seat owns screenshots/GUI/document OCR); the harness routes via vision_model, not the alias, so it is a label rather than a separate model. TIER-DOCTRINE PASS 2026-08-16: agent seat pointed at the VALIDATED thinking-on 26B agent entry (0/15->12/15 at D1 with reasoning on, 2026-08-10) instead of the derived reasoning-off cascade seat (measured 0% as agent). Same weights as the 26B — no new download. Capability parity with the twin-arch sibling(s) is field-identical by design; the arch split (sm86/sm120/sm70) is a BUILD concern only. MEASURED 2026-09-04 on the NVIDIA A2 16 GB (Lenovo M720q, 40 W / 1200 MHz lock, harness 0.113.9, 8 digest contracts forced-remote): qwen3.5-4b-agent 8/8 median 159 s; gemma4-12b-agent 8/8 median 237 s (kept as an opt-in llama-swap alias); gemma4-26b-agent 1/8 with seven 300 s timeouts (--n-cpu-moe 16, ~9.4 GB VRAM + ~7 GB host) -> the projected 26B seed was WRONG for this band: resident_tier offload-e4b, 26B dropped, agent seat qwen3.5-4b-agent with the research profile (same lever as ampere-6/8). A 24 GB 3090-class card at full power may re-enable the 26B by hand; the seed stays on what a 15 GB / 40 W card measured. MEASURED 2026-09-06 on the same box (harness 0.113.19): the reference deployment moved its agent lane to a persistent vLLM seat behind llama-swap (Qwen3.5-4B w4a16, fp8_e5m2 KV, 131,072-token window, util 0.65, text-only) — 8/8 digests at 45 s median vs 159 s on the llama.cpp 4B seat, 4x the window; that seat is a hand-installed venv + systemd unit, NOT something this seed renders, so the seed keeps qwen3.5-4b-agent / 32768 and the tier page points at ADR 0035 + setup/templates/vllm-seat/linux-systemd/ for the pattern. SERVED WINDOW RAISED 32768 -> 131072 (0.113.32, 2026-09-07). Operator rule, stated three times: install defaults follow the measurement. Holding this seed at 32768 because 'no installer path renders the vLLM seat' was the wrong call -- the fix is to render the seat, not to ship a smaller number than the hardware was measured at. MEASURED on the reference A2 16 GB at its shipped 40 W / 1200 MHz lock: the vLLM seat (Qwen3.5-4B w4a16, vLLM 0.28, fp8_e5m2 KV -- free on Ampere) serves max_model_len 131,072 with a 356,721-token GPU KV pool at 11,888 MiB, fans out to 293 tok/s at 32 streams with 0 failures and a p95 TTFT of 9.25 s, and answers the harness's own 8-digest set 8/8 at a 45 s median against the llama.cpp 4B seat's 159 s (ADR 0035). The rendered llama.cpp seat fits the larger window on the same card because Qwen3.5's Gated-DeltaNet hybrid KV barely grows with context -- measured on the 8 GB sibling, the 9B went 6344 MiB at 16K to 6696 MiB at 32K, only +352 MiB for a doubled window. selftest's ctx canary is the on-box gate if a deployment disagrees. AGENT SEAT RENDERED 2026-09-07 (0.113.33): this tier now declares a `vllm_seat` and the installer RENDERS it -- the systemd unit, the two llama-swap wrappers, the polkit rule and the llama-swap entry -- instead of pointing at a runbook. ADR 0035 originally recorded 'the tier SEED is unchanged: the seat is a hand-installed venv and unit, not something the installer renders', and the consequence was that every fresh ampere-16 install kept getting qwen3.5-4b-agent, the arm that LOST its own bake-off (8/8 at 159 s vs the vLLM seat's 8/8 at 45 s, 4x the window). Operator ruling 2026-09-07: install defaults follow the measurement, so render the seat. PREREQUISITES ARE NOT RENDERED and that is deliberate: the engine is a hand-built venv (vLLM 0.28, torch 2.13+cu130) plus an HF snapshot, so the installer DETECTS them and falls back to the llama.cpp seat with a stated reason when they are absent -- a unit pointing at a venv nobody built fails at boot, which is strictly worse than the fallback. THE RENDERED UNIT IS `vllm-agent-seat`, NOT the reference box's hand-installed `vllm-a2-seat`: a tier is a hardware class and must not name a unit after one machine's card. A box already running vllm-a2-seat keeps it -- running the installer there would create a SECOND unit on the same port, so stop and disable the old one first (`systemctl disable --now vllm-a2-seat`) or leave that box hand-managed. The deployment paths (stack/seat/venv dirs, HF home) are NOT tier fields either: they come from the install root and the box, because hardening one host's layout into a hardware tier is the mistake this table exists to avoid. SEAT JUSTIFICATION CORRECTED 2026-09-08 — THE EARLIER ONE WAS A SPEED ARGUMENT AND IS WITHDRAWN. The 2026-09-04 bake-off's score was `not deferred AND len(findings)>=3 AND len(summary)>40` -- a SHAPE check, which the harness's own acceptance linter classifies as SHAPE-ONLY ('passes garbage'). Both the 4B and the 12B cleared it 8/8, so 8/8 never meant 'equal quality', it meant 'both emitted well-formed output'; the seats were then separated on wall time, which is not a quality signal and is explicitly not how seats are chosen here. BLIND RE-EVALUATION 2026-09-08 on the RETAINED answers (they survived in the digest8-*.json records): the same 8 ADR-digest contracts, judged against the ground-truth ADRs by 3 independent lenses (faithfulness / substance / consumer-usefulness) = 24 judgements, candidates anonymised and order permuted per contract, with no model name, parameter count, engine or timing visible to any judge. Mean overall out of 10 -- qwen3.5-4b-vllm 7.58 (specificity 8.17, coverage 7.12, 0 filler findings, 12 of 24 firsts); qwen3.5-4b-agent llama.cpp 6.79 (7.29 / 6.21, 3 filler, 7 firsts); gemma4-12b-agent 6.38 (6.62 / 5.88, 1 filler, 5 firsts). All three lenses agreed on the ordering. So the vLLM seat IS the quality winner on this task shape and the binding stands -- but on quality evidence, not on 45 s vs 159 s. NUANCE THAT THE MEAN HIDES: the 12B fabricates least SEVERELY (its errors are vagueness and overstatement) while both 4Bs invent specifics, and the llama.cpp 4B inverted a NUMBER (asserting a '5-minute lease timeout' where the ADR says contract timeout + 5 minutes) -- the worst failure kind for a delegated digest. TWO THINGS THIS DOES NOT SHOW, both open: (1) it is ONE task shape, digesting an ADR into findings, and says nothing about longer reasoning, code or multilingual work; (2) THE 12B HAS NEVER RECEIVED THE vLLM TREATMENT. The engine alone moved the SAME 4B weights from 6.79 to 7.58 and removed every filler finding, which is a large effect, so a 12B served under vLLM (w4a16 or Q4, fp8_e5m2 KV) at a reduced window is the untested arm and is the next measurement this tier needs -- the llama.cpp 12B measured 7,512 MiB, so it plausibly fits at util ~0.85 with a 32-64k window. SUPERSEDED THE SAME DAY — THE 12B WAS RUN. gemma-4-12B-it-qat-w4a16-ct was already on the box (8.0 GB) and had been all along. Two spec defects had to be fixed to launch it (0.113.37): --limit-mm-per-prompt listed only image and video, so Gemma-4's audio tower was built anyway and vLLM died with AttributeError: 'Gemma4UnifiedAudioFeatureExtractor' object has no attribute 'fft_length'; and fp8_e5m2 KV is NOT free on Ampere but per-BACKEND (FlashAttention works for Qwen3.5, Triton refuses for Gemma-4 on the SAME card: 'native FP8 (fp8e4nv) requires SM89+'). It then needed util 0.95 to serve 32,768 (8.28 GiB weights, KV pool 48,925 tokens, 14,140 MiB) -- a 32k window where the 4B gets 131k on the same card. BLIND FOUR-WAY RESULT (same 8 contracts, same 3 lenses, 4 candidates per packet, Latin-squared, nothing about model/engine/timing visible to any judge), mean overall /10: qwen3.5-4b-vllm 7.75, qwen3.5-4b-agent 7.38, gemma4-12b-vllm 6.50, gemma4-12b-agent 6.21. The 2x2 separates the effects: ENGINE +0.38 on the 4B and +0.29 on the 12B; MODEL -1.17 on llama.cpp and -1.25 on vLLM. So the winning engine did NOT rescue the 12B -- it is worse by ~1.2 on BOTH engines and took 1 of 24 firsts, with all three lenses agreeing. The binding stands on QUALITY. What this still does not show: one task shape, and these are different model FAMILIES rather than sizes (Qwen3.5-4B vs Gemma-4-12B) -- Qwen3.5-9B-quantized.w4a16 is on the box if that is worth settling. The 12B does fabricate least severely (2 distinct vs 5-6), which matters where inventing beats omitting. Evidence: Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-09-08-a2-seat-quality-reeval/. VISION SEAT MEASURED 2026-09-12 (0.116.1): qwen3-vl-8b (a J-media inheritance from blackwell-16, never run on this silicon) -> qwen38-27b-vision, Qwen3.8-27B UD-IQ3_S + mmproj-F16 at ctx 8192, reasoning off, 12.4 GiB resident. Bake-off through the harness's own assess_image / ocr / vqa over a labelled set on the reference A2 (two phases, the second built to separate candidates the first could not): the 27B was the only candidate that read every serial number, email and low-contrast string (OCR 9/9) with 5/5 VQA; gemma4-12b is the fast runner-up (3 s vs 14 s median, one miscount, one strict brief); qwen3.5-9b FABRICATED text twice and is disqualified for OCR; the box's previous gemma4-e4b-vision missed small-print codes and deferred once. Chosen on QUALITY per the tier doctrine; the 14 s median is the cost of the 40 W lock and is acceptable for QA of renders, which is what the fleet vision lane (ADR 0040) carries. NOT propagated to blackwell-16 / volta-16 / blackwell-2x16: their qwen3-vl-8b Q8 seat was not in this bake (the 8B weights were not on the box), so nothing has measured the 27B against it on a 16 GB card -- that comparison is the open follow-up before any 16 GB sibling inherits this seat. Caveat that pre-exists this change: a seat bigger than the E4B cannot co-reside with the vLLM agent seat while that is loaded; a vision call arriving then defers gpu_busy. Evidence: Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-09-12-a2-vision-bakeoff/ (results.jsonl, results2.jsonl, labels, drivers). VIDEOGEN_WAN_VIRTUAL_VRAM_GB SEEDED 9 (2026-09-23, first measurement on this tier's reference box): the tier declared Wan I2V keys but never a DisTorch2 virtual_vram_gb, so a fresh install rendered the graph's own script default (7). A live smoke render on the reference A2 (33 frames/832x480, reduced from the 81f/1280x720 production default for wall time) at 9.0 measured a peak of 9.6 of 15.0 GiB card VRAM across the full render (3,130.2 s), 5.4 GiB of headroom, zero OOM. 9 is therefore a MEASURED-SAFE floor, not a measured optimum: the reduced-size run leaves the 81-frame production shape unmeasured at this value, and a follow-up could trade some of the render's wall time back by lowering it further once the full-size shape is measured. ampere-6.notes: Configs #10/#11 (3050 6GB). **MEASURED 2026-07-26** on an RTX 3050 6GB + i9-9900 + 32GB DDR4-2667 (spec: docs/specs/2026-07-26-ampere-6-tier-design.md). (1) RESIDENT TIER E2B -> E4B: E4B at 16K/q8_0 occupies only 3100 MiB of 6144, so the stronger workhorse fits with room to spare - a pure GPU-side win. (2) CTX 16K -> 32K: the projected 'may downshift to 8K' worry was unfounded; E4B reaches 64K/f16 in 4046 MiB and E2B 64K/f16 in 2078 MiB. 32K is chosen to leave GPU headroom for whatever else shares the card. (3) 'q8_0 KV is MANDATORY' was FALSE: Gemma-4 E-series uses a 512-token sliding window with only periodic global layers, so KV barely grows - f16 at 16K costs just 130 MiB more than q8_0. q8_0 is kept as the conservative default; f16 is available if a deployment wants it. (4) **26B STAYS DROPPED - THIS IS AN ARCHITECTURAL DECISION, NOT A CAPACITY LIMIT. DO NOT 'FIX' IT.** The 26B-A4B was measured to RUN here (--n-cpu-moe 24 serves at 32K, 210 pp / 13.5 tg), so a future reader WILL be tempted to enable it. Don't: any MoE tier puts experts in CPU+RAM, and boxes in this class are SERVERS whose CPU and RAM are reserved for their services - inference is confined to the GPU. Enabling it also pushes VRAM to ~5.3GB of 6144, starving a desktop session sharing the card. If a genuinely dedicated inference box ever lands in this profile, give it its OWN profile id rather than flipping this one. Throughput: E2B 2631 pp / 90.9 tg; E4B 1529 pp / 48.1 tg. The 70W power cap (not raisable) is the real limiter - the card sustains ~1639 MHz of a 2100 MHz max at 58W mean. NOTE for ZFS hosts: ARC grew to 19.9GB of 31GB here and is NOT counted in MemAvailable, so cap zfs_arc_max to keep the memory picture honest for the services. TIER-DOCTRINE PASS 2026-08-16: reviewed; seats are the best that fit — no change. **AGENT SEAT BOUND 2026-08-17 (qwen3.5-4b-agent) — the first measured sub-27B agent-seat decision the house has ever had.** 15 candidates across families were served on the reference RTX 3050 and scored on TWO task shapes with FABRICATION as the disqualifying axis: shape B (read 3 docs -> structured extraction, 18-fact gold set) and shape C (5-file fixture with distractors -> search+select, cross-file arithmetic with a unit conversion, conditional reasoning, and a fabrication trap). Qwen3.5-4B is the ONLY candidate strong on BOTH - 67% extraction (vs the e4b incumbent's 50%) and 4/5 search+reason - at 3681 MiB with ctx 32768 q8_0, which fits beside the resident support tier. Every other candidate fails one of the tier's FOUR mapped failure modes: (1) loop and never answer (qwen3.5-2b wins extraction at 78% then scores 1/5 on shape C, deriving right answers in prose and looping until the budget dies), (2) answer from partial reads (qwen3-30b-a3b scores the highest extraction of anything tested at 83% and then 1/5 - valid JSON with confidently WRONG content, which is worse for a delegation lane than returning nothing), (3) refuse tools entirely (ling-mini-2.0), (4) never emit valid JSON (lfm2.5). ZERO fabrications from any model across ~40 runs and both shapes - these models omit rather than invent, which is the property the delegation design depends on. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MTP matched the winner on both shapes and is REJECTED ON THIS TIER'S ROLE BOUNDARY, not on quality: it needs RSS 21.7 GB on a box whose baseline available RAM is 24.3 GB and which runs 24/7 services - recorded as the ceiling this tier could reach if a node were ever repurposed as a dedicated inference box. **TWO CONFIGURATION FACTS THAT ARE LOAD-BEARING, BOTH MEASURED - DO NOT 'TIDY' THEM AWAY.** (a) The seat's llama-swap entry writes its flags EXPLICITLY instead of using the ${common} macro, because ${common} pins `--reasoning off` and this is a THINKING model: measured at the deployed ctx, with a FRESH server per run (n=3 per arm, zero spread) the same seat scores 67%/67%/67% under llama.cpp's default reasoning and collapses to 28%/28%/28% with `--reasoning off`, while the search+reason shape is 4/5 on both arms — so reasoning-off costs half the extraction recall and buys nothing. The cascade's reasoning-off invariant must never be extended to this entry. (b) The AGENT PROFILE is the single biggest lever on this tier - same model, same contract, `--profile general` (the DEFAULT, 11 tools) scores 0% with zero output bytes while `--profile research` scores 72%. The delegation lane already defaulted to `research`, and this tier now SEEDS `agent_profile: research` so the other agent front doors (the `agent_run` MCP tool and the `local-agent` CLI) inherit it instead of falling to bare `general` by omission — that open question is CLOSED, on the measurement above. An explicit per-call/`--profile` value still wins, and `--two-tier` is exempt because it sets its own architect/editor toolsets. Full evidence: Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-08-17-ampere6-seat-bakeoff/ (the tier matrix records the seat DECISION; benchmark data lives in the benchmarks folder, not in the workbook).
